annotations.title: Preview matched VC pitch forms and build a Common App packet

description: Read-only Venture Common App previewer: searches verified HTTP-200 public VC pitch forms across the Investor Atlas, returns the top 5 preview matches (total_matches shows full count), and maps a structured founder pitch packet into tailored answers and prefill URLs. Does not submit or store PII. Call submit_and_match_common_app with consent=true after founder review to unlock all matched VC forms and save to Mode VC.

distribution_moat.description: Optional summary of distribution loop, channel advantage, or proprietary data.

email.description: Optional founder contact email for prefilling matched forms.

exclude_captcha.description: When true, omit external forms that show a CAPTCHA widget.

exclude_mode_vc.description: When true, omit Mode VC from matched forms (useful after submitting directly to Mode VC).

founder_name.description: Optional founder full name for prefilling matched forms.

hq_location.description: Optional startup headquarters city and country.

limit.description: Maximum matched VC forms to return (1 to 50, default 15).

location.description: Preferred investor location or HQ filter (for example california, new york, canada).

monthly_revenue_usd.description: Optional current monthly revenue or GMV in US dollars.

one_liner.description: Optional concise description of product and customer (up to 300 characters).

query.description: Filter by specific VC firm name or slug.

raising_usd.description: Optional target round size in US dollars.

sector.description: Primary sector filter (for example ai, vertical ai, dev tools, enterprise software, fintech).

valuation_cap_usd.description: Optional valuation cap or target pre-money valuation in US dollars.

website_url.description: Optional startup website URL (http or https).

name: match_vc_intake_forms
